_note: Affiliate (commission) tags by site. The app adds them to Get tickets, Merch and Watch links on that site (and its subdomains). Use a tracking-link template with {url} (Impact deep links) or a param + value; those links show the small commission note. A rule with "ref": true is a referral tag only (no commission, no note; app 1.2.6+, so don't add one while older versions are around). Ticket links without a rule get Ringside Radar's referral tag from the app (utm_source=ringsideradar; Eventbrite aff=ringsideradar). Add "off": true to pause one. See DATA.md → Affiliate links.
